verdict.rationale: mParticle supports conditional forwarding rules (e.g., 'do not forward if CCPA opt-out present') and audience-to-output connections that activate when audience membership criteria are met, which are rule-like automations triggered by data events. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose rule/workflow engine for arbitrary event-triggered actions beyond consent-based forwarding and audience activation. Missing for 10: a documented general automation/rules engine (if-this-then-that style), evidence of custom action triggers beyond forwarding/audience activation, and independent confirmation of this capability working in practice.
